title: The charcoal kitchen
description: A charcoal high-gloss kitchen with a working island, white stone-look tops and red-framed glass display cabinets, by Malepe R&R.
intro: A dark, reflective kitchen with a working island at its centre: hob and oven set into the island, charcoal high-gloss doors and white stone-look tops. One run of red-framed glass display cabinets is the only colour in the room.
body: Gloss this dark shows every misaligned door and every uneven gap, so the joinery has to be exact. Long bar handles run in one line across the base units; the tall unit beside the window closes the composition.
The island carries its own cooking zone, so the room works as a kitchen and a place to stand and talk.

photos.caption: Display cabinets above the sink run

title: White gloss U-kitchen
description: A white high-gloss U-shaped kitchen photographed during installation and at handover, by Malepe R&R.
intro: Photographed twice: once with the window still under plastic, and again at handover. The same U-shaped run of white high-gloss doors and drawers, from fitted carcasses to a clean room.
body: A white gloss kitchen is unforgiving in the other direction: every scuff and every fingerprint shows. The drawer bank under the window and the full-height units on the right are set out to the same lines as the ceiling.

title: White gloss kitchen with breakfast bar
description: A white high-gloss kitchen with built-in oven, tall units and a breakfast counter, from installation to handover, by Malepe R&R.
intro: Tall units frame a built-in oven and hob, with a breakfast counter returning into the room. During installation the shelving was still open and the floor covered in offcuts; at handover, stools at the counter.
body: Two photographs, the same room: the record of a job going from carcass to kitchen.
